To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

LSTM-RNN acoustic models can be speaker-adapted by incorporating speaker information in the model training, and that the speaker-aware training can be further improved by joint training of phone and speaker models.

1) speaker-aware training of LST-RNNs can reduce WER by 6.6% relative to a strong LSTM-RNNs baseline, 2) speaker-aware training with bottleneck vectors outperforms speaker-aware training with I-vectors, and 3) joint training of speaker-aware and phone aware models can achieve further improvement.
LSTM-RNN based speaker-aware training can significantly reduce the word error rates in the speech transcription task.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the speaker-aware training of the LSTM-RNNs, and the experimental results show that the proposed speaker-aware LSTM-RNNs outperform the LSTM-RNN baselines.
the speaker-aware training of LSTMs and its application in speech recognition.
the LSTM-RNN acoustic model, speaker-aware training, and multi-task learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
LSTM-RNN speaker-adaption is an effective technique that can improve recognition accuracy.
the speaker-aware training of RNNs, in particular LSTM-RNNs, is a very effective technique that can significantly improve the performance of acoustic modelling.
the LSTM-RNNs are more robust to the speaker variability than the DNNs, and the speaker-aware training can further improve the robustness of the LSTM-RNN based speech recognition systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

speaker-aware training of LSTMs is a powerful tool that can improve the performance of acoustic modelling, and the speaker information can be represented by I-vectors, speaker bottleneck vectors and speaking rate, and the best performance is achieved by using I-vectors.
speaker-aware training of the LSTM-RNNs is very effective and the speaker information can be incorporated in various ways.

LSTM-RNN based speaker-aware training is a very effective approach to reduce the speaker variability, which can be further improved by using the bottleneck speaker vectors as the speaker representation and the phone-aware joint training.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the speaker-aware training of LSTMs is a very effective technique for improving LSTM-RNN acoustic models, which is also applicable to DNN acoustic models.
LSTM-RNN models are highly sensitive to speaker information and can benefit significantly from speaker-aware training.
speaker-aware training of RNNs is an important direction to improve the robustness of RNN-based acoustic models.
